name: @iolab/nz-markets-mcp
description: MCP server for NZ lending-rate, capital-market, and electricity-market research: Rates API mortgage/personal-loan/car-loan/credit-card rates (no key required), NZXplorer NZX-listed company/announcement data (requires an NZXplorer API key), and Electricity Authority ICP connection lookups plus real-time dispatch prices (requires two EA subscription keys).
